ranking_unavailable: The top-10 breakdown cannot be shown (the official table has no values by individual municipality, or they are aggregated or withheld). The figure above is the official total.
ranking_note: The ranking shows the top municipalities and wards listed individually in the official table. Places grouped under "others" or other aggregate rows are not ranked, so this is not a complete ranking of all municipalities. The figure above is the official total, not the sum of the ranking.
age_unknown_note: The four age groups exclude "unknown" ages (listed separately in the official table), so they may add up to less than the total.
